description: This file defines the AlertsProvider class, which manages alert data for a Flutter app. It extends ChangeNotifier and uses a use case to load alerts, notifying listeners when data is updated.

classes.name: AlertsProvider
classes.description: A provider class for managing alert data in a Flutter application, using ChangeNotifier for state management.

methods.name: AlertsProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a GetAlerts use case and loads alerts immediately.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads alerts from the use case and notifies listeners about data update.
